response:
It is completely understandable that you are feeling this way. You are carrying an immense load—working 50 hours a week and solo-parenting two kids—while watching your husband suddenly live a carefree life. Hearing him say he misses you and wants to adore you now, after you spent five years feeling emotionally starved, must feel incredibly confusing and unfair. It makes sense that his sudden shift doesn't just erase the years of loneliness you endured when he was physically present but emotionally absent. 

Your feelings of resentment and exhaustion are entirely valid, and you don't have to force yourself to accept this new dynamic overnight. It might be helpful to honestly communicate to him how this contrast is affecting you, perhaps with the guidance of a couples or individual counselor to help navigate these complex emotions. Please remember to be gentle with yourself right now, and see if there are any ways you can find local support or small moments of rest amidst your heavy daily responsibilities.
